content.short: Ammplify is a Monad LP aggregator pairing market-making fees with options-style payoffs.
content.description: Ammplify combines liquidity provision income with option-like payoff structures on Monad, acknowledging that an LP position already behaves somewhat like a short volatility trade and building on that rather than hiding it. Framing the position honestly is more useful than quoting an APR that ignores impermanent loss.
content.meta: Monad liquidity aggregation that treats an LP position as the volatility trade it already is.
